name: Glow Dental & Aesthetics
tagline: Gentle dental care in the heart of SS15
hours: Monday-Saturday 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.

faq.parking: Street parking is available along Jalan SS15/4D, and there is covered parking at SS15 Courtyard, a 2-minute walk away.
faq.payment: We accept cash, debit/credit cards, DuitNow QR, Touch 'n Go eWallet and GrabPay.
faq.insurance: We are a panel clinic for most major insurers and company panels. Please bring your panel card or letter of guarantee.
faq.cancellation: You can reschedule or cancel free of charge up to 4 hours before your appointment.
faq.location: We are at 12, Jalan SS15/4D, Subang Jaya, about 5 minutes' walk from SS15 LRT station.
